shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Canada’s minister responsible for trade with the United States, Dominic Leblanc, said U.S. tariffs have made some parts of the Canadian economy difficult, but Canada is not rushing to reach a bad agreement.

title: Dominic Leblanc Says Canada Is Not Rushing Into a Bad Trade Deal With the U.S.
